verdict.rationale: Turso documents and exposes a public API (database provisioning, token-scoping, SQL execution) per turso-docs-8/12, plus SDKs in multiple languages (turso-docs-13) and a live Hrana HTTP API confirmed via runtime probe (turso-probe-rt-2), and a hosted MCP endpoint for agent-driven control (turso-docs-9, turso-probe-rt-3). No formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (turso-probe-3), and community evidence doesn't specifically corroborate API completeness beyond SDK usage. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent hands-on confirmation of the REST/management API beyond SQL execution.
